sports.headline: Nike signs Mexico flag football captain Diana Flores ahead of LA28 Olympic debut
sports.summary: Two-time world champion Diana Flores, who captains and plays quarterback for Mexico, has joined Nike as its fourth women's flag football athlete. She will help shape Nike's flag football footwear and apparel. Flag football makes its Olympic debut at LA28, and Nike's $5m girls' flag football grant with the NFL sits behind the push. Nike's own announcement and NBC Sports coverage date from 23 November. The 26 November date used here is the Yahoo Sports/LA Times interview, and Sportico also covered the signing in its 27 November roundup.

fashion.headline: Fashion Awards 2026: Ncuti Gatwa to host, Yohji Yamamoto to receive Outstanding Achievement Award
fashion.summary: The British Fashion Council has named Ncuti Gatwa host of the Fashion Awards at the Royal Albert Hall on 30 November. Yohji Yamamoto receives the Outstanding Achievement Award, Awar Odhiang is Model of the Year and Sandra Choi gets a Special Recognition Award. The Designer of the Year nominees include The Row, Saint Laurent, Tom Ford (Haider Ackermann), Chanel, Celine and Givenchy. The event is the main fundraiser for the BFC Foundation.

fashion.headline: Martine Rose and Nike unveil the Trax MR, a track-spike-inspired sneaker due in December
fashion.summary: The Trax MR reworks vintage sprinting spikes into a lifestyle sneaker with an exaggerated, elongated toe. It extends the pair's Shox MR4 collaborations. Rose has also reworked the Nike packaging, adding a vintage-style 'There Is No Finish Line' ad insert shot by Roxy Lee. Reports point to a December 2026 release at about $200. Nike has not yet confirmed the release details.
